title: Theme settings with live preview
problem: The shop's website looked the same for everyone; colours were written into each page and nothing could be changed.
now: About sixty options in nine groups change colours, fonts, cards, product and category pages, cart, footer and extras, with a live preview, draft and publish.
steps: Open Online Store › Theme and press Customize
Type WhatsApp in the search box and change the chat button
Open Brand & colours, change the primary colour and watch the preview on Phone
Press Publish, then open the store: the new colour shows; Undo in the message puts it back
